title: Curated gear presets for the exposure tools (ADR-0012)
refresh: Re-check every source_url at least once a year, and the iPhone rows each September when new iPhones ship. Never fetched at runtime.

sensor_size_basis.manufacturer: The maker's published sensor dimensions (or DPReview's mirror of them).
sensor_size_basis.stated-pitch-x-pixels: iPhone: pixel pitch x 4032 x 3024. Apple publishes no sensor size; this matches EXIF focal lengths better than optical-format strings.
sensor_size_basis.optical-format estimate: Converted from an inch-type string like 1/1.28". Approximate; kept only as optical_format_estimate_mm.

pixel_pitch_basis.exif-measured: From a real frame's EXIF on the owner's phone (CAPTURE-LIMITS.md). Authoritative.
pixel_pitch_basis.stated: Pitch printed by the source (GSMArena spec sheets for iPhones).
pixel_pitch_basis.stated-native-x2-binned: 2 x the stated 48 MP pitch: the 12 MP quad-Bayer binned output the app captures.
pixel_pitch_basis.sensor-width/pixels: Sensor width ÷ image width x 1000 (the SkyCore formula).

focal_length_basis.manufacturer: The lens's marked focal length (zooms: the wide end).
focal_length_basis.exif-measured: EXIF FocalLength of a real photo.
focal_length_basis.derived-from-equivalent: Apple's 35 mm-equivalent ÷ crop factor of the pitch-implied sensor.
focal_length_basis.derived-from-measured-fov: Measured horizontal field of view and the pitch-implied sensor width.

lenses.name: 14mm F1.4 DG DN Art
lenses.coma: Reviewers report coma and astigmatism very well controlled even wide open at f/1.4, with well-defined star points to the corners; some reports of sample variation.
lenses.value_basis: Focal length and max aperture: manufacturer spec (see source_url).

lenses.name: 14-24mm F2.8 DG DN Art
lenses.coma: Reviewed as excellent corner sharpness with well-controlled coma across the zoom range at f/2.8; Digital Camera World and Cameralabs both rate it among the sharpest ultra-wide zooms.
lenses.value_basis: Focal length and max aperture: manufacturer spec (see source_url).
lenses.notes: Zoom 14–24 mm; preset at the wide end.

lenses.name: 20mm F1.4 DG DN Art
lenses.coma: Capture the Atlas calls it the "best overall lens for Milky Way photography"; Fstoppers' astronomy-focused review found coma extremely well controlled with only slight winging at extreme corners.
lenses.value_basis: Focal length and max aperture: manufacturer spec (see source_url).

lenses.name: 24mm F1.4 DG DN Art
lenses.coma: Called out by AstroBackyard as its top pick for Milky Way single-frame shots for its sharpness and light gathering.
lenses.value_basis: Focal length and max aperture: manufacturer spec (see source_url).

lenses.name: 15mm F1.4 DG DN Diagonal Fisheye Art
lenses.coma: Sigma states the design specifically corrects sagittal coma flare for astrophotography; PetaPixel's 2024 review calls the design strong for star points across the 180° field.
lenses.value_basis: Focal length and max aperture: manufacturer spec (see source_url).
lenses.notes: Fisheye: NPF assumes a rectilinear lens, so treat it as a centre-of-frame guide.

lenses.name: FE 14mm F1.8 GM
lenses.coma: Photography Life reports coma essentially eliminated wide open, pinpoint stars to the corners; LensTip measured relatively high astigmatism (~25.7%) increasing off-axis.
lenses.value_basis: Focal length and max aperture: manufacturer spec (see source_url).

lenses.name: FE 20mm F1.8 G
lenses.coma: Capture the Atlas notes it as "lightweight (373g), sharp corners, popular choice" for Milky Way work.
lenses.value_basis: Focal length and max aperture: manufacturer spec (see source_url).

lenses.name: FE 24mm F1.4 GM
lenses.coma: Not independently sourced in this pass; general reputation as a sharp GM prime but no dedicated astro/coma citation captured.
lenses.value_basis: Focal length and max aperture: manufacturer spec (see source_url).

lenses.name: FE 12-24mm F2.8 GM
lenses.coma: Not independently sourced in this pass for coma-specific ratings; included on spec completeness and Capture the Atlas's zoom recommendations for ultra-wide astro/landscape crossover.
lenses.value_basis: Focal length and max aperture: manufacturer spec (see source_url).
lenses.notes: Zoom 12–24 mm; preset at the wide end.

lenses.name: NIKKOR Z 14-24mm f/2.8 S
lenses.coma: Not independently sourced for coma in this pass; included for spec completeness as Nikon's flagship ultra-wide zoom, widely used for Milky Way landscapes per Nikon's own marketing and Photography Life's review.
lenses.value_basis: Focal length and max aperture: manufacturer spec (see source_url).
lenses.notes: Zoom 14–24 mm; preset at the wide end.

lenses.name: NIKKOR Z 20mm f/1.8 S
lenses.coma: Mixed reviews: Photography Life/Digital Camera World call coma/astigmatism minimal even wide open; LensTip measured astigmatism at 12.9% ("borderline medium/high") with coma pronounced in corners on some samples.
lenses.value_basis: Focal length and max aperture: manufacturer spec (see source_url).

lenses.name: NIKKOR Z 14-30mm f/4 S
